title: Add GET /api/stats endpoint to Flask blog
description: A Flask blog app needs a single JSON statistics endpoint that returns total, published, and draft post counts.

task_spec.prompt:
The Flask blog in src/app.py has a list of posts and existing routes (/, /posts/<id>, /admin, /api/posts, POST /api/posts). Add one new endpoint:

GET /api/stats — returns JSON {"total": N, "published": P, "drafts": D} where:
  total = number of all posts
  published = number of posts with published=True
  drafts = total - published

Also add 2 tests in tests/test_blog.py:
  test_stats_counts — calls GET /api/stats, checks total/published/drafts against the initial data
  test_stats_after_new_post — creates a draft via POST /api/posts then re-checks /api/stats

All 6 original tests must still pass. Run uv run pytest tests/ -q to confirm.
success_criteria: All original tests unmodified and passing
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
